fact.title: Gratuity: payment within 30 days
fact.claim: Gratuity must be paid within 30 days. It is separate from final wages.
fact.caveat: Reported in the same article as the 2-day wages rule. You need about 5 years of service; two High Courts accept 4 years and 240 days.

script.cover_1: You served for years and left. Where is the gratuity?
script.payoff: A report says gratuity must be paid within 30 days.
script.caption: Gratuity is easy to forget and easy to delay. Send this to a senior colleague who is about to leave.
script.situation: Can your company make you wait months for your gratuity?
script.answer: A report says gratuity must be paid within 30 days. It needs about 5 years of service.
